constraints.name: VerificationAttempt_evidence_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((version > 0) AND (kind = ANY (ARRAY['identity'::text, 'signature'::text])) AND (environment = ANY (ARRAY['sandbox'::text, 'production'::text])) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'verified'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'expired'::text, 'consumed'::text])) AND ("browserNonceHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND ("requestHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND ("documentHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (("providerRequestHash" IS NULL) OR ("providerRequestHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND ("expiresAt" > "createdAt") AND ((status <> ALL (ARRAY['verified'::text, 'consumed'::text])) OR (("verifiedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("providerRequestHash" IS NOT NULL) AND ("providerRequestCipher" IS NOT NULL)))))

constraints.name: VerificationEvent_evidence_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((("providerEventHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND ("bodyHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND ("verificationStatus" = ANY (ARRAY['verified'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'ignored'::text])) AND (("verificationStatus" <> 'verified'::text) OR "signatureValid")))

constraints.name: VerificationIntegration_configuration_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK (((version > 0) AND (environment = ANY (ARRAY['sandbox'::text, 'production'::text])) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'disabled'::text, 'deleted'::text])) AND (("identityProvider" IS NULL) OR ("identityProvider" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,63}$'::text)) AND (("signatureProvider" IS NULL) OR ("signatureProvider" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,63}$'::text)) AND
CASE
    WHEN (status = 'deleted'::text) THEN (("identityProvider" IS NULL) AND ("signatureProvider" IS NULL))
    ELSE (("identityProvider" IS NOT NULL) OR ("signatureProvider" IS NOT NULL))
END))

constraints.name: VerificationReceipt_evidence_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((kind = ANY (ARRAY['identity'::text, 'signature'::text])) AND (environment = 'production'::text) AND ("documentHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND ("proofHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND ("retentionUntil" > "verifiedAt")))
